Line1.name: Line 1
Line1.definition: First line of information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

Line2.name: Line 2
Line2.definition: Second line of information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

StreetName.name: Street Name
StreetName.definition: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

BuildingNumber.name: Building Number
BuildingNumber.definition: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

PostalCode.name: Postal Code
PostalCode.definition: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

TownName.name: Town Name
TownName.definition: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

CountrySubDivisionMinor.name: Country Sub Division Minor
CountrySubDivisionMinor.definition: Identifies a minor subdivision of a country, for instance county, prefecture.|In accordance with ISO 3166-2 or the local authority.

CountrySubDivisionMajor.name: Country Sub Division Major
CountrySubDivisionMajor.definition: Identifies a major subdivision of a country, for instance state, province.|In accordance with ISO 3166-2 or the local authority.

CountrySubDivisionMajorName.name: Country Sub Division Major Name
CountrySubDivisionMajorName.definition: Name of a major subdivision of a country, for instance county, prefecture.

CountrySubDivisionMinorName.name: Country Sub Division Minor Name
CountrySubDivisionMinorName.definition: Name of a minor subdivision of a country, for instance county, prefecture.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Nation with its own government occupying a particular territory.|In accordance with ISO 3166-1.

GeographicLocation.name: Geographic Location
GeographicLocation.definition: Location of the acceptor in latitude/longitude decimal degrees.
